# user-data-rights

DSGVO-compliant in 5 LOC: r.useExtension(EXT_USER_DATA, ...) haengt eine Domain an Forget+Export-Pipeline. Forget-Cron, Export-ZIP, Magic-Link kommen alle aus user-data-rights.

## README

# user-data-rights

GDPR-compliant domain wiring in ~5 lines: `r.useExtension(EXT_USER_DATA, …)`
hooks any entity into the forget cron, export ZIP, and magic-link pipeline.
You write two hooks per entity — the framework runs the rest.

## What it shows

A minimal notes domain with GDPR Art. 15+17+20 integrated without hand-written
forget logic:

```ts illustration
defineFeature("notes", (r) => {
  r.requires({ features: ["user-data-rights"] });
  r.entity({ name: "note", ...noteEntity });

  r.useExtension(EXT_USER_DATA, "note", {
    export: async (ctx) => ({
      entity: "note",
      rows: await ctx.db
        .select()
        .from(notesTable)
        .where(and(eq(notesTable.tenantId, ctx.tenantId), eq(notesTable.authorId, ctx.userId))),
    }),
    delete: async (ctx, strategy) => {
      const where = and(eq(notesTable.tenantId, ctx.tenantId), eq(notesTable.authorId, ctx.userId));
      if (strategy === "anonymize") {
        await ctx.db.update(notesTable).set({ authorId: null }).where(where);
      } else {
        await ctx.db.delete(notesTable).where(where);
      }
    },
  });
});
```

## What runs automatically

| Article      | What happens                                   | Trigger                                |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Art. 15 + 20 | Notes snippet in export ZIP + magic-link email | `runUserExport` (via `request-export`) |
| Art. 17      | Notes deleted or anonymized after grace        | `runForgetCleanup` cron                |
| Art. 18      | Restriction blocks login while active          | Auth middleware                        |
| Operator     | Brute-force detection on magic-link endpoint   | Edge rate-limit + audit log            |

## Strategy-aware delete

`retention.policyFor("note")` resolves per entity:

| Profile              | Strategy                    | Effect                                        |
| -------------------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `eu-dsgvo` (default) | `delete`                    | Notes hard-deleted                            |
| `de-hr-dsgvo-hgb`    | `anonymize` for HR entities | `authorId=null`, row kept for multi-user refs |

The integration test pins both paths.

## Flow

1. User creates notes → rows stored with `authorId`.
2. `request-export` queues job → `runUserExport` bundles user + note rows.
3. `request-deletion` → grace period from compliance profile.
4. `runForgetCleanup` calls your `delete` hook with resolved strategy.

## Tests

Needs a running Postgres and `TEST_DATABASE_URL` set (e.g. `postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres`, see `demo/.env.example`).

```bash
bun test src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts
```

Step-by-step proof:

1. Alice creates 2 notes → export bundle includes note snippet
2. Deletion + expired grace → `runForgetCleanup` removes all notes
3. Strategy `anonymize` → `authorId=null`, title/body remain

## Retention with files

`runRetentionCleanup` is exported for app tests. A `hardDelete` entity with a file field loses
its bytes (and derivatives), its `file_refs` row and then the row itself; a storage error keeps
the row and reports `file_delete_failed` in `skipped`. `src/retained-docs.ts` holds the entity,
`src/__tests__/retention-files.integration.test.ts` drives the run with only public imports:

```ts illustration
import { runRetentionCleanup } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/data-retention";
import { createFileContext } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/files";

const result = await runRetentionCleanup({
  db: stack.db,
  registry: stack.registry,
  tenantId,
  preloadedTenantPreset: null,
  now: getTemporal()
    .Now.instant()
    .add({ hours: 31 * 24 }), // keepFor 30d + 1 day
  files: createFileContext(() => Promise.resolve(provider)), // the stack's storage provider
});
// result.hardDeleted === 1, bytes and file_refs row gone
```

### src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts

```ts
// User-data-rights recipe — integration test.
//
// Pins that the two hooks from feature.ts do exactly what the recipe
// README promises:
//   1. The user's notes land in the bundle snippet via the export hook.
//   2. The forget-cleanup cron removes the notes via the delete hook (strategy
//      "delete", default).
//   3. Strategy "anonymize" (HR override) sets authorId=null instead of
//      deleting — the row stays intact for multi-user refs.

import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { createAuthFoundationFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/auth-foundation";
import {
  createComplianceProfilesFeature,
  tenantComplianceProfileEntity,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/compliance-profiles";
import {
  createDataRetentionFeature,
  tenantRetentionOverrideEntity,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/data-retention";
import { createSessionsFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/sessions";
import {
  tenantMembershipEntity,
  tenantMembershipsTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant";
import {
  createUserFeature,
  USER_STATUS,
  userEntity,
  userTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/user";
import {
  createUserDataRightsFeature,
  runForgetCleanup,
  runUserExport,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/user-data-rights";
import { insertOne, selectMany } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
import { EXT_USER_DATA } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { getTemporal } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/time";
import { seedRowViaEventStore } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/helpers";
import {
  setupTestStack,
  type TestStack,
  unsafeCreateEntityTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { noteEntity, notesFeature, notesTable } from "../feature";

let stack: TestStack;

// Each test gets its own tenant and user, so rows from other tests never show up.
let testNumber = 0;
let TENANT_A = "";
let ALICE_ID = "";
let ALICE_EMAIL = "";

type Instant = InstanceType<ReturnType<typeof getTemporal>["Instant"]>;
const NOW = (): Instant => getTemporal().Now.instant();
const PAST = (): Instant => getTemporal().Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(Date.now() - 60_000);

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({
    features: [
      createUserFeature(),
      createAuthFoundationFeature(),
      createSessionsFeature(),
      createDataRetentionFeature(),
      createComplianceProfilesFeature(),
      createUserDataRightsFeature(),
      notesFeature,
    ],
  });
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, userEntity);
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, noteEntity);
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, tenantRetentionOverrideEntity);
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, tenantComplianceProfileEntity);
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, tenantMembershipEntity);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

beforeEach(() => {
  testNumber += 1;
  const suffix = String(testNumber).padStart(12, "0");
  TENANT_A = `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${suffix}`;
  ALICE_ID = `11111111-1111-4111-8111-${suffix}`;
  ALICE_EMAIL = `alice-${testNumber}@recipe.test`;
});

function noteId(index: number): string {
  return `aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-${String(testNumber * 10 + index).padStart(12, "0")}`;
}

async function seedAlice(opts: { gracePeriodEnd?: Instant; status?: string } = {}): Promise<void> {
  await seedRowViaEventStore(stack.db, userTable, {
    id: ALICE_ID,
    email: ALICE_EMAIL,
    passwordHash: "h",
    displayName: "Alice",
    locale: "de",
    emailVerified: true,
    roles: '["Member"]',
    status: opts.status ?? USER_STATUS.Active,
    gracePeriodEnd: opts.gracePeriodEnd ?? null,
  });
  await seedRowViaEventStore(stack.db, tenantMembershipsTable, {
    tenantId: TENANT_A,
    userId: ALICE_ID,
    roles: '["Member"]',
  });
}

async function seedNote(id: string, title: string): Promise<void> {
  await insertOne(stack.db, notesTable, {
    id,
    tenantId: TENANT_A,
    authorId: ALICE_ID,
    title,
    body: `body for ${title}`,
  });
}

describe("user-data-rights recipe :: EXT_USER_DATA-Hooks integrieren Notes-Domain", () => {
  test("Export-Bundle enthaelt Note-Snippet via Hook", async () => {
    await seedAlice();
    await seedNote(noteId(1), "first");
    await seedNote(noteId(2), "second");

    const bundle = await runUserExport({
      db: stack.db,
      registry: stack.registry,
      userId: ALICE_ID,
      now: NOW(),
    });

    const tenantA = bundle.tenants.find((t) => t.tenantId === TENANT_A);
    const noteSnippet = tenantA?.entities.find((e) => e.entity === "note");
    expect(noteSnippet?.rows).toHaveLength(2);
    expect((noteSnippet?.rows ?? []).map((r) => String(r["title"])).sort()).toEqual([
      "first",
      "second",
    ]);
  });

  test("Forget-Cron strategy=delete entfernt Notes (Default-Pfad)", async () => {
    await seedAlice({ status: USER_STATUS.DeletionRequested, gracePeriodEnd: PAST() });
    await seedNote(noteId(1), "to-delete");

    const result = await runForgetCleanup({
      db: stack.db,
      registry: stack.registry,
      now: NOW(),
    });
    expect(result.processedUserIds).toContain(ALICE_ID);

    const remaining = await selectMany(stack.db, notesTable, { tenantId: TENANT_A });
    expect(remaining.length).toBe(0);
  });

  test("Strategy=anonymize: authorId=null, row remains (HR-Compliance path)", async () => {
    await seedAlice();
    await seedNote(noteId(1), "stays-anonymous");

    const usage = stack.registry
      .getExtensionUsages(EXT_USER_DATA)
      .find((u) => u.entityName === "note");
    const hooks = usage?.options as
      | {
          delete?: (
            ctx: { db: typeof stack.db; tenantId: string; userId: string },
            strategy: "delete" | "anonymize",
          ) => Promise<void>;
        }
      | undefined;
    await hooks?.delete?.({ db: stack.db, tenantId: TENANT_A, userId: ALICE_ID }, "anonymize");

    const after = await selectMany(stack.db, notesTable, { tenantId: TENANT_A });
    expect(after).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(after[0]?.authorId).toBeNull();
    expect(after[0]?.title).toBe("stays-anonymous");
  });
});
```

### src/__tests__/retention-files.integration.test.ts

```ts
// runRetentionCleanup is public API: an app test drives the retention run with its own `now`
// and the stack's storage provider, then checks that the file bytes, the file_refs row and the
// entity row are gone and the erasure is on the audit trail.

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import {
  createDataRetentionFeature,
  runRetentionCleanup,
  tenantRetentionOverrideEntity,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/data-retention";
import { selectMany } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
import { eventsTable } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/event-store";
import {
  createFileContext,
  createFilesFeature,
  createInMemoryFileProvider,
  fileRefsTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/files";
import { createTestUser, testTenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { getTemporal } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/time";
import {
  buildMultipartBody,
  patchFileInstanceofForBunTest,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/helpers";
import {
  setupTestStack,
  type TestStack,
  unsafeCreateEntityTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { retainedDocEntity, retainedDocsFeature } from "../retained-docs";

const CREATE = "retained-docs:write:retained-doc:create";
const DETAIL = "retained-docs:query:retained-doc:detail";
const tenantId = testTenantId(61);
const admin = createTestUser({ id: 61, tenantId, roles: ["Admin"] });
const provider = createInMemoryFileProvider();

let stack: TestStack;

beforeAll(async () => {
  patchFileInstanceofForBunTest();
  stack = await setupTestStack({
    features: [createFilesFeature(), createDataRetentionFeature(), retainedDocsFeature],
    files: { storageProvider: provider },
  });
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, retainedDocEntity, "retained-doc");
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, tenantRetentionOverrideEntity);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

async function upload(): Promise<string> {
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append("entityType", "retained-doc");
  fd.append("fieldName", "attachment");
  fd.append(
    "file",
    new File([Buffer.from("%PDF-1.4 minimal")], "doc.pdf", { type: "application/pdf" }),
  );
  const { body, contentType } = await buildMultipartBody(fd);
  const res = await stack.app.request("/api/files", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${await stack.jwt.sign(admin)}`,
      "Content-Type": contentType,
    },
    body,
  });
  expect(res.status).toBe(201);
  return ((await res.json()) as { id: string }).id;
}

describe("user-data-rights recipe :: retention run removes a hardDelete entity's files", () => {
  test("after keepFor + 1 day the row, its bytes and its file_refs row are gone; the erasure is audited", async () => {
    const fileRefId = await upload();
    const created = await stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
      CREATE,
      { title: "contract", attachment: fileRefId },
      admin,
    );
    const [fileRef] = await selectMany<{ storageKey: string }>(stack.db, fileRefsTable, {
      id: fileRefId,
    });
    const storageKey = String(fileRef?.storageKey);
    expect(await provider.exists(storageKey)).toBe(true);

    const result = await runRetentionCleanup({
      db: stack.db,
      registry: stack.registry,
      tenantId,
      preloadedTenantPreset: null,
      now: getTemporal()
        .Now.instant()
        .add({ hours: 31 * 24 }),
      files: createFileContext(() => Promise.resolve(provider)),
    });

    expect(result.hardDeleted).toBe(1);
    expect(result.skipped).toEqual([]);
    expect(await provider.exists(storageKey)).toBe(false);
    expect(await selectMany(stack.db, fileRefsTable, { id: fileRefId })).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(await stack.http.queryOk(DETAIL, { id: created.id }, admin)).toBeNull();

    const forgotten = await selectMany(stack.db, eventsTable, { aggregateId: created.id });
    expect(forgotten.map((e) => (e as { type: string }).type)).toContain("retained-doc.forgotten");
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// User-Data-Rights — recipe
//
// How an app domain integrates the GDPR pipeline: one
// (export, delete) hook per entity via EXT_USER_DATA. Forget cron, export ZIP build
// and magic link delivery come entirely from user-data-rights —
// the app author writes only the two hooks per entity.
//
// Demo domain: minimal note service. A note has (id, tenantId, authorId,
// title, body). Pins:
//   1. The export hook delivers note rows as a JSON snippet into the export bundle.
//   2. The delete hook removes note rows during the forget-cleanup cron.
//
// What is not in the recipe (see samples/apps/user-data-rights-demo
// for a complete app):
//   - Strategy-aware delete (anonymize vs hardDelete)
//   - HTTP endpoints for create/list
//   - Compliance profile wiring + cron scheduling

import {
  deleteMany,
  deriveEntityTableMeta,
  selectMany,
  updateMany,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
import {
  createEntity,
  createTextField,
  defineFeature,
  EXT_USER_DATA,
  type UserDataDeleteHook,
  type UserDataExportHook,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";

export const noteEntity = createEntity({
  table: "store_notes",
  idType: "uuid",
  fields: {
    authorId: createTextField({ personal: "ref" }),
    title: createTextField({
      personal: false,
      reason: "is_business_data",
      required: true,
      maxLength: 200,
    }),
    // Plaintext on purpose: store_notes is an unmanaged direct-write store, so the
    // PII executor never encrypts it. Art. 17 runs through the EXT_USER_DATA
    // hook below instead (deletes the author's rows, or unlinks them on anonymize).
    body: createTextField({
      personal: false,
      reason: "covered_by_user_data_hook",
      maxLength: 4000,
    }),
  },
});

// Plain EntityTableMeta, NOT a branded EntityTable: store_notes is a deliberate
// unmanaged direct-write store (r.storeTable below), so the forget hook may
// updateMany/deleteMany it directly — the meta carries no executor-only brand.
export const notesTable = deriveEntityTableMeta("note", noteEntity, { source: "unmanaged" });

export const notesFeature = defineFeature("notes", (r) => {
  r.requires({ features: ["user-data-rights"] });
  // store_notes is a direct-write store: the forget hook below `updateMany`/
  // `deleteMany`s rows WITHOUT emitting lifecycle events. r.entity would make
  // it a rebuildable implicit projection whose replay finds zero note events
  // and wipes the table (or un-forgets anonymized rows) on the next rebuild
  // (#498). r.storeTable keeps the DDL, opts out of implicit rebuild.
  r.storeTable(notesTable, {
    reason: "read_side.notes_direct_write",
  });

  const exportNotes: UserDataExportHook = async (ctx) => {
    const rows = await selectMany(ctx.db, notesTable, {
      tenantId: ctx.tenantId,
      authorId: ctx.userId,
    });
    if (rows.length === 0) return null;
    return {
      entity: "note",
      rows: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: String(row.id),
        title: row.title ?? "",
        body: row.body ?? "",
      })),
    };
  };

  const deleteNotes: UserDataDeleteHook = async (ctx, strategy) => {
    const where = { tenantId: ctx.tenantId, authorId: ctx.userId };
    if (strategy === "anonymize") {
      await updateMany(ctx.db, notesTable, { authorId: null }, where);
    } else {
      await deleteMany(ctx.db, notesTable, where);
    }
  };

  r.useExtension(EXT_USER_DATA, "note", {
    export: exportNotes,
    delete: deleteNotes,
  });
});
```

### src/retained-docs.ts

```ts
// Retention with files: a hardDelete entity whose file field is cleaned up together with the
// row. runRetentionCleanup removes the bytes (and derivatives) and the file_refs row first,
// then the row itself; the cron in data-retention does the same with the tenant's FileContext.

import {
  createEntity,
  createFileField,
  createTextField,
  defineEntityCreateHandler,
  defineEntityDetailHandler,
  defineFeature,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";

export const retainedDocEntity = createEntity({
  table: "store_retained_docs",
  fields: {
    title: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
    attachment: createFileField(),
  },
  retention: { keepFor: "30d", strategy: "hardDelete", reference: "createdAt" },
});

export const retainedDocsFeature = defineFeature("retained-docs", (r) => {
  r.entity({ name: "retained-doc", ...retainedDocEntity });
  r.writeHandler(
    defineEntityCreateHandler("retained-doc", retainedDocEntity, {
      access: { roles: ["Admin"] },
    }),
  );
  r.queryHandler(
    defineEntityDetailHandler("retained-doc", retainedDocEntity, {
      access: { roles: ["Admin"] },
    }),
  );
});
```
